0.original: Edilaude looks as if she's ready to take on the world.

24.original: Use the coal to light the fireworks on Quill's Trace.

25.original: Use the coal to light the fireworks on the Mattock.

26.original: Use the coal to light the fireworks on the Abacus.

48.original: If it isn't the savior of Ishgard, in the flesh! You couldn't have come at a better time. How would you like to assist the illustrious Edilaude, Ishgard's preeminent pyrotechnician, in her latest foray into the realm of sky-spanning aesthetic excellence?

49.original: Say no more─of course you would! Here, take this coal into hand and use it to set the masterpiece I've placed over on Quill's Trace aflame. I promise you, the result will be nothing short of scintillating!

50.original: Well, what are you waiting for? Go and set my marvelous invention ablaze already! Every second you tarry, you deprive the world of my sheer aesthetic mastery!

51.original: Oho! Now there's a sight to behold. Edilaude kept saying how she was slaving away in her workshop on the project of a lifetime, but I figured she was just blowing hot air again.

52.original: You honor us with your presence, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>. Just between you and me, I couldn't help but notice a similar-looking device sitting all alone atop the Mattock, and a group of children eagerly gathered around it. Perhaps Edilaude means to put on a show for them as well?

53.original: Edilaude just dropped this here and ran off laughing like a woman possessed. Whatever could it be?

54.original: I'm sure nothing would delight the children more than to see the sky filled with a blaze of colors.

55.original: The sky! It's sparkling! I've never seen anything so beautiful!

56.original: Hey, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>! I saw another one of those tubes over on the Abacus. Do you think that one will make the sky light up, too?

58.original: Come on, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>! Make the sky light up again!

59.original: Oh, what beautiful fireworks! I've not seen such a sight since...well, it's been many years. Still, what a lovely way to celebrate the restoration of the Firmament.

60.original: And how fitting is it that the one to ignite the blaze is none other than the very hero who delivered our fair nation from war? Thank you, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>. Do pass on my regards to dear Edilaude next time you see her.

61.original: Not a day goes past that I do not give thanks for all you have done for us, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>. But whatever brings you here today?

62.original: Truth be told, Edilaude's the daughter of a dear friend of mine. The girl's always been a touch eccentric, but she's got a good heart in her.

63.original: She fought bravely in the war, but I heard she was struggling to find good work in recent days. It's good to know she's found a new passion to pursue.

64.original: Who gave you permission to set off <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> the fireworks, you fool!? But I jest! I was hoping you would do just that. Why, I saw the sight from here, and I do believe it's safe to say that I am every ilm the genius that I always knew myself to be! Did the townspeople appreciate my masterwork as much I did?

65.original: Of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103> they did! The incredible spectrum of colors, the unsurpassed elegance with which they dance and dart through the sky─only a fool or a blind man would fail to appreciate the spectacle!

66.original: But my true dream doesn't end there. Take a look at this beauty beside me.

67.original: Bertha here was my pride and joy when I served on the front lines. I couldn't count the number of times she saved me from the ravaging claws of the Horde.

68.original: When the war ended, I figured she'd just end up all alone, collecting dust in the dark corner of some storehouse. So I offered to take her home myself, with the promise that I'd keep her well maintained and put her to good use─and my natural aptitude for pyrotechnics has allowed me to do just that.

69.original: We may no longer have need for weapons to shoot dragons out of the sky, but I mean to give Bertha here a new life shooting sheer beauty into the sky, and bringing joy and hope to the people of our nation.

70.original: But why stop at Ishgard? Yes, one day I will journey across all of Eorzea with Bertha in tow, lighting up the skies in all corners of the realm with a spectacular rainbow of fiery blossoms!

71.original: For the part you've played in helping me realize my life's work, I thank you. As do, no doubt, all who will one day bear witness to the wonders that you have helped me introduce to the world!

72.original: And with that, I give you leave to resume your travels. But wherever you roam, always look to the sky─for you never know when Edilaude's fabulous fireworks will return to grace your eyes once more!
